JINGLES_ENABLED_HINT: When enabled, jingles uploaded and marked "on air" will be inserted between songs during the live stream.
JINGLES_RANDOM_HINT: A jingle will play at a random point - after the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd song in a row.
JINGLES_FREQUENCY_HINT: How many songs should play before a jingle runs (1–5).
jinglesEligibilityDay: ⚠ Day: {used} of the required {min} active - jingles won't air.
jinglesEligibilityNight: ⚠ Night: {used} of the required {min} active - jingles won't air.
PHRASES_ENABLED_HINT: When enabled, one of the uploaded phrases will be mixed into the song a few seconds before it ends.
PHRASES_RANDOM_HINT: If enabled, one of the uploaded phrases is picked at random for each song. If disabled, pick one fixed phrase below.
PHRASES_DEFAULT_TIME_HINT: If enabled, the phrase is always inserted 15 seconds before the song ends.
PHRASES_TIME_SECONDS_HINT: How many seconds before the song ends the phrase is inserted ({min}–{max}s).
phrasesNeedMoreDay: Day: {used} of the required {min} active - upload and enable at least {min} to turn this on.
phrasesNeedMoreNight: Night: {used} of the required {min} active - upload and enable at least {min} to turn this on.
